title: CI Fidelity: JSDOM Synthetic Clicks vs Real Browser Hit-Testing
description: Compare a green JSDOM test that bypasses layout and touch listeners against a real Chromium Playwright test that catches the unclickable mobile dropdown.

before.label: JSDOM + Enzyme/RTL Synthetic Test (False Green)
before.previewNote: Passes 100% in CI even when a sticky header overlay intercepts every tap at (x, y) in production.

after.label: Real Chromium Engine + A11y Locator (Playwright)
after.previewNote: Fails immediately with 'element intercepts pointer events' when the sticky backdrop covers the trigger.
